name: Vegas Connection

identity.note: A separate entity from vegas-connection (AAWC), not a merge. Re-verified 2026-09-02 on the identity-join test and UPGRADED from presumed to primary-source: the earlier filing rested on "no corroborating link beyond the shared name", but both feds' own documents name their own team's members, and the two memberships do not overlap. This team is "Lounge Lizard" Lester Leary and Larry Lowbrow — WWO's own tag-team roster page bills them under this name, each man's own bio card gives "Tag Team Name: The Vegas Connection" and names the other as his partner, and both are led by the manager Rimshot. The AAWC's team is Aaron Reno and Steven Gage, walked out by the manager Lady Luck on that fed's own Oktoberfest '96 (Night 1) card of 25 October 1996. Different eras and platforms too — the AAWC pair runs 1995-96 on the PRODIGY boards, this one holds the WWO World Tag Team titles in 2001 — and this row's own bio-card travelogue of where the team had been (the ECCWF, the STWF, the MBC, the PMCW/RCCW/BDCW) names neither the AAWC nor the CSWA. NOTE FOR ENRICHMENT: this row still carries membership_unknown, which the fed's own roster and bio cards contradict; left standing here because this pass was scoped to the guard alone, and flagged for the WWO wing.
